question: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.
gold_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School' AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3

    f.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.SOCType) = 'continuation school'
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL

2. For those sets, which ones have `mtgoCode IS NOT NULL` in the `sets` table?
3. Is there at least one set containing `Angel of Mercy` whose `mtgoCode` is not null, and at least one such set whose `mtgoCode` is null?

SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.name
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT DISTINCT s.*
FROM sets AS s
JOIN cards AS c
  ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.mtgoCode IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS has_both
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy';

WITH angel_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate, s.mtgoCode
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_mtgo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mtgoCode IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_non_mtgo
  FROM angel_sets
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN has_mtgo > 0 THEN 'yes'
    ELSE 'no'
  END AS appeared_on_magic_the_gathering_online,
  CASE
    WHEN has_mtgo > 0 AND has_non_mtgo > 0 THEN 'both'
    WHEN has_mtgo > 0 THEN 'only mtgoCode non-null'
    ELSE 'only mtgoCode null'
  END AS distribution,
  code,
  name
FROM angel_sets, stats
ORDER BY releaseDate, code;
